notes.title: The long awaited update has finally arrived at the station!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We are so excited to bring you this new update as we know a lot of you have been wanting [b]multiple trains[/b] since we launched! We really hope you love this new addition and all the other features we’ve included as part of this major update🙂 [/p][p]Watch the updated trailer here![/p][previewyoutube="G7GMJWxHyhg;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][h3]Here's what there is to look forward to:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42509697/fd899fdcafc5a82b75c1af5be29c6c947d1fb4bf.png"][/img]

notes.title: New city builder Islands and Trains is a relaxing alternative to Cities Skylines
notes.content:
There's something tremendously relaxing about putting together the perfect rail network. Games like Cities Skylines are great for it, but sometimes the overarching management elements can be overwhelming. Transport Fever 3 is on the way, but what about something simpler, prettier, and cozier, and that you can play right now? Islands and Trains delivers exactly what it promises, and once you've seen it in action you'll immediately understand why it caught my eye. Out now on Steam, this is pure delight at a budget price.

notes.title: Islands & Trains is about exactly what it sounds like, and it's out today
notes.content:
What do you think Islands & Trains is about? I'm not going to give you long, because it really is just right there in the name. As you've presumably already guessed, it is a quaint-looking sandbox builder where you make tiny diorama-like islands, adorning them with tracks for trains to choo-choo along. I told you, it's a name that does what it says on the tin, and if it appeals to you at all, well, there's some good news, as it just came out today.

Read more

notes.title: Dev Update - Mass building & removing implemented
notes.content:
Greetings !
We know, we know.

We have been doing a terrible job at keeping you in the loop.
We truly want to apologize for that.

----------------------

To make up for it, we want to share with you one of the bigger features we really worked hard on for Islands&Trains in the past months. It, rightfully, has been one of the biggest criticism about the building.

[b]*drumroll*[/b]
You no longer have to click individually to place terrain or anything else.

[b]Yes, you read that right ![/b]

You can now just make a selection and you will get your piece of terrain instantly.
This will surely make the creation of bigger levels (which, let's be honest, all of you want) much much more joyful and healthier 😆

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42509697/4fa0ec631b7e862483a7643488a1ea93c5ca46c6.gif[/img]

As you can see, you can use the same idea to remove huge chunks of your creation, all at once.
If you start your selection on the ocean layer, everything gets removed. If you start on your terrain, only these portions get removed.

This can work with whatever asset we see fit.
E.g. if you want to build big forests you can either make the selection or you can hold the mouse button and just paint your trees naturally.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42509697/0d824bdc9ad9f59821b997b4ed54cb9c04d0dd23.gif[/img]

It's 3D Bob Ross 🥰

Thank you for being so supportive and understanding through our journey so far. We really hope you will embrace what we have worked on in the past year and we can't wait to share more with you in the future.

We are doing our best to get this game into the [i]most bestest[/i] shape we possibly can.

Hugs to all of you 🧡,
Akos & Fabian

notes.title: Demo update (increased level size&terrain height, TUNNELS, wagons & much more)
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

We are so excited to announce the release of our new demo !
We have worked so hard to implement lots of new content for you to enjoy.

[h2]Increased level size and terrain height levels[/h2]
You can now build PRETTY big levels in Islands&Trains and we have tripled the terrain building height, as well which should give you plenty of freedom for all kinds of lovely builds

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42509697/e85d752612b02cfbfec7451de3bb3cde4628acfe.png[/img]


[h2]TUNNELS[/h2]
Omg yes, we now have a first iteration of tunnels in the game. The UI experience is a bit clunky in places but you can build straight and curved tunnels and watch your train travel through it.
Plus: you can even build terrain on top of the tunnels !

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42509697/b5d5009fe422a6f92da6651387f9d2d54a409064.png[/img]

[h2]Castles[/h2]
Among many many new assets we have implemented a series of castle pieces, which you can use to build something like this:

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42509697/a410946173e1c552234b9d800ef7df7c22a9dc04.png[/img]

[h2]What else ?[/h2]
[list]
[*] New train engines and wagons
[*] Waterfalls
[*] Buildings
[*] Track pieces
[*] Animals
[*] and and and
[/list]

[h2]What is next ?[/h2]

Now that we put so much new content in and changed the game significantly in scope we want to focus on improving the usability. We know that it can get quite exhausting to click once for each terrain piece, so we will adress that in the future so you can really go big and still have a smile on your face instead of a look of desperation.

We will also overhaul the controls and camera since we have to take into account how big you can build now and sometimes you have areas where you can't look into, depending on how high you have built.

Thank you for support and patience during the development of Islands&Trains and we hope you enjoy these updates !
